removedAmbiguous.reason: The orange station object could be a service cart or machine; its function is not visually certain.
Tiny roadside posts are visible, but button faces are not resolved at native pixels.
Plate rectangles exist, but characters and jurisdiction are illegible.
Vehicle emblems are too small to identify reliably.
Wheel-service hardware overlaps; a brake disc cannot be isolated with confidence.
Blue depot machinery is real but its exact maintenance function is ambiguous.
Red cylinders may be extinguishers or workshop gas bottles; no readable markings.
Several hoses and service units are visible, but the pump body is not unambiguous.
The operator area is visible, but the steering wheel is occluded.
The low platform beside cargo could be a scale or simple pallet base.
No anchor shape is sufficiently resolved on any vessel.
The motorboat stern is partly occluded and propulsion hardware is not clearly visible.
Small white mast fittings may be lights or antennas rather than radar hardware.
Fishing gear supports are visible, but no actual net mesh can be resolved.
Human-like depot shapes are too small or equipment-like to label safely.
the platform band at (736, 298) has no resolvable tactile bumps or ribs and was retained only as a platform safety strip
the point at (1183, 298) resolves only a wheel rim; the flange profile is not pixel-defensible and the separate wheel anchor already covers it
the small wall placard at (1635, 278) has no legible warning symbol or warning content
the cabinet at (85, 798) has no visible hazard label or containment evidence
the wrapped load at (770, 760) does not prove that its contents are a cabinet
the assembly at (919, 735) contains pipes but does not resolve a defensible manifold topology
the vessel at (1450, 800) is a fishing boat, but no deployed trawl gear proves the trawler subtype
the angled member at (1510, 730) is visible as a rigging boom, while outrigger function is not provable
the winch at (1525, 780) has no visible connected net and was retained as a generic deck winch
the drum at (1535, 760) has no visible net and was retained as a generic deck cable drum
